title: Last Mover Advantage
coreMove: Evaluate a company by the value it can keep earning after the first excitement fades.
sourcePressure: The chapter shifts from escaping competition to asking what kind of business value endures over time, warning against mistaking firstness or novelty for durable strength. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning durability into generic patience or long-term thinking without business mechanics.
